refnamediv.refpurpose: Creates a pair of indistinguishable sockets and stores them in an array

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
domain
The domain parameter specifies the protocol family to be used by the socket: AF_UNIX, AF_INET6 or AF_INET. On Linux, only AF_UNIX works, and on Windows only AF_INET: the other families fail with an error from the system.
type
The type parameter selects the type of communication to be used by the socket, for example SOCK_STREAM, SOCK_DGRAM or SOCK_SEQPACKET (AF_UNIX).
protocol
The protocol parameter sets the specific protocol within the specified domain to be used when communicating on the returned socket. On Linux, it must be 0: another value, such as SOL_TCP, fails with "Protocol not supported".
pair
Reference to an array in which the two Socket instances will be inserted.
